title: FastFoto Linux corpus manifest
description: Documentation of the manifest. The loader (corpus_manifest.py) is hand-written and is the authority; a test keeps this file in step with its constants. Per-feature annotation payloads are validated by the harnesses that use them.

split_seed.description: Seed of the tuning/heldout split (the same rule as red-eye's split_salt).

id.description: Opaque: never a name of a person or place.

path.description: Relative POSIX path under the manifest directory; no symlink component.

split.description: Must equal the split derived from split_seed, the group (or sha256).

source.description: Where the item came from. Never copied into reports.

group.description: A print, its rescans and crops: they share one split.
